convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load a custom indicator 'HullTrendOSMA' and depends on two external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh for trade execution and SmoothAlgorithms.mqh for smoothing algorithms). The custom indicator and its smoothing methods must be replicated manually.

derived_values.name: SqrXLength - Integer square root of XLength used as secondary Hull MA period
min_rates_total - Minimum bars required for indicator warmup

other_exits: BuyPosClose triggered when HullTrendOSMA[1]>HullTrendOSMA[2] (downtrend signal), SellPosClose triggered when HullTrendOSMA[1]<HullTrendOSMA[2] (uptrend signal), each gated by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input booleans

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lot size, BALANCE=percent of balance, FREEMARGIN=percent of free margin, LOSSFREEMARGIN=percent of free margin accounting for losses, LOSSBALANCE=percent of balance accounting for losses. MM=0.1 interpreted according to MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: Entry requires two conditions met simultaneously: (1) trend direction determined by HullTrendOSMA[1] vs HullTrendOSMA[2] comparison on the signal bar, AND (2) momentum confirmation via HullTrendOSMA[0] vs HullTrendOSMA[1]. For long: Value[1]<Value[2] (was declining) AND Value[0]>=Value[1] (now turning up). For short: Value[1]>Value[2] (was rising) AND Value[0]<=Value[1] (now turning down). SignalBar input (default=1) allows using a bar other than the most recent completed bar. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose input booleans act as independent gate switches for each direction's entry and exit. LoadHistory() is called each tick to ensure bar data is available. Recount flag triggers re-evaluation on the next tick if CopyBuffer fails.
python_conversion_notes: The HullTrendOSMA custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python. It uses the SmoothAlgorithms.mqh library which provides JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, and AMA smoothing methods beyond standard MT5 MAs. The Hull calculation involves: WMA(price, XLength), WMA(WMA(price, XLength), SqrXLength), then 2*WMA1 - WMA2, followed by a second smoothing pass with XMA_Method1/XLength1/XPhase1. The OSMA component implies an oscillator derived from the Hull trend. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, and GlobalVariableDel_ functions which must also be reimplemented. Position sizing logic varies by MarginMode enum - all 5 modes must be supported. SL/TP values are in points (not pips), so no 5-digit adjustment is needed since they are input directly by the user.
